anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: A broad, convex parabolic arc with a large pixel radius, forming the primary structural boundary of the dorsal-anterior cranium.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: A short, distinct protrusion tapering from the cranial base, characterized by a high width-to-length pixel ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: An obtuse interior angle visible at the pixel junction where the melon’s distal slope meets the proximal base of the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Several irregular, desaturated (light-colored) patches and linear striations are visible along the mid-dorsal spinal ridge, indicative of skin abrasions or depigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: The entire organism exhibits intense, uniform green luminescence across the visible epidermal layer, obscuring finer-scale texture in high-intensity regions.
